record.name: 龙息术
record.text: 造成$4点伤害。在本回合中每有一个随从死亡，本牌的法力值消耗便减少（1）点。
record.text_en: Deal $4 damage. Costs (1) less for each minion that died this turn.

record.name: 加工失误
record.text: 抽三张牌。如果你的牌库里没有随从牌，这三张牌的法力值消耗减少（3）点。
record.text_en: Draw 3 cards. If your deck has no minions, they cost (3) less.

record.name: 海床传送口
record.text: 抽一张机械牌。使你手牌中所有机械牌的法力值消耗减少（1）点。
record.text_en: Draw a Mech. Reduce the Cost of Mechs in your hand by (1).

record.text: 随机召唤两个法力值消耗为（$2）的随从（受法术伤害加成影响）。

record.name: 华丽谢幕

record.text_en: Summon an 8/8 Elemental. Repeat for each Elemental you played last turn.

record.name: 霜巫十字绣

record.text_en:
Deal $2 damage to all minions. Summon a 2/2 Volatile Skeleton

record.text_en: Summon three 3/6 Water Elementals that Freeze. They attack random enemies.

record.text_en: Deal $2 damage randomly split among all enemy minions. (2 Drinks left!)

record.text: 造成$2点伤害，随机分配到所有敌方随从身上。（最后一杯！）
record.text_en: Deal $2 damage randomly split among all enemy minions. (Last Drink!)

record.name: 水元素

record.text: 亡语：随机对一个敌人造成2点伤害。
record.text_en: Deathrattle: Deal 2 damage to a random enemy.

record.name: 热浪来袭
record.text: 对一个敌方随从及其相邻随从造成$2点伤害。快枪：改为对所有敌人。
record.text_en: [x]Deal $2 damage to an enemy minion and its neighbors. Quickdraw: To all enemies instead.

face.name: 龙息术
face.text: 造成 4点伤害。在本回合中每有一个随从死亡，本牌的法力值消耗便减少（1）点。
face.flavorText: 大家都知道龙能够喷吐火焰，但你知道其实它们也能喷吐棉花糖吗？只是通常来说，它们缺少一个喷吐棉花糖的理由而已。

face.name: Dragon's Breath
face.text: Deal 4 damage. Costs (1) less for each minion that died this turn.
face.flavorText: Dragons breathe fire, sure, but did you know they can also breathe Cotton Candy? It's harder to give them a reason to do that, though.

face.name: 加工失误
face.text: 抽三张牌。如果你的牌库里没有随从牌，这三张牌的法力值消耗减少（3）点。
face.flavorText: 你肯定觉得生产这种只有9块的拼图不是什么难事，对吧？

face.name: Manufacturing Error
face.text: Draw 3 cards. If your deck has no minions, they cost (3) less.
face.flavorText: You thought the 9-piece puzzle would be easy, didn't you?

face.name: 海床传送口
face.text: 抽一张机械牌。使你手牌中所有机械牌的法力值消耗减少（1）点。
face.flavorText: 旅途鱼快！

face.name: Seafloor Gateway
face.text: Draw a Mech. Reduce the Cost of Mechs in your hand by (1).
face.flavorText: It's all about e-fish-ency.

face.name: 鲁莽试验
face.text: 随机召唤两个法力值消耗为（ 2）的随从（受法术伤害加成影响）。
face.flavorText: 科学更是一门艺术，很多人意识不到这一点。

face.name: Unexpected Results
face.text: Summon two random 2-Cost minions (improved by Spell Damage).
face.flavorText: Sometimes science is more art than science. A lot of people don’t get that.

face.name: 华丽谢幕
face.text: 召唤一个8/8的元素。你在上个回合每使用一张元素牌，重复一次。
face.flavorText: 一想到暗月马戏团的其他种种危险，肆意纵火都显得那么人畜无害。

face.name: Grand Finale
face.text: Summon an 8/8 Elemental. Repeat for each Elemental you played last turn.
face.flavorText: Considering all the other hazards at Darkmoon, overindulgent pyrotechnics seem downright pedestrian.

face.name: 霜巫十字绣
face.text: 对一个角色造成 3点伤害。如果该角色死亡，召唤一个3/6的可以冻结攻击目标的水元素。
face.flavorText: 水人本身并不可怕，可怕的是它的主人！

face.name: Frost Lich Cross-Stitch
face.text: Deal 3 damage to a character. If it dies, summon a 3/6 Water Elemental that Freezes.
face.flavorText: Do not fear power... Fear those who SEW IT!

face.name: 死神之躯
face.text: 对所有随从造成 2点伤害。每消灭一个随从，召唤一个2/2的不稳定的骷髅。
face.flavorText: 其实只是普通的骷髅。克尔苏加德取这个名字只是为了气势。

face.name: Deathborne
face.text: Deal 2 damage to all minions. Summon a 2/2 Volatile Skeleton for each killed.
face.flavorText: Kel'Thuzad thinks adding a silent 'e' at the end of words makes them sound cooler.

face.name: 海啸
face.text: 召唤三个3/6的可以冻结攻击目标的水元素，并使其随机攻击敌人。
face.flavorText: 下来吧，这里的水很清凉！还很生气。而且活起来了。

face.name: Tsunami
face.text: Summon three 3/6 Water Elementals that Freeze. They attack random enemies.
face.flavorText: Hop in, the water's cold! And angry. And alive.

face.name: 银樽海韵
face.text: 造成 2点伤害，随机分配到所有敌方随从身上。（还剩3杯！）
face.flavorText: 如果觉得生活不如意，不妨试试杯口再多沾一点盐！

face.name: Seabreeze Chalice
face.text: Deal 2 damage randomly split among all enemy minions. (3 Drinks left!)
face.flavorText: If your luck has been particularly poor lately, try the extra salted rim!

face.name: 热浪来袭
face.text: 对一个敌方随从及其相邻随从造成 2点伤害。快枪：改为对所有敌人。
face.flavorText: 这是你人生中迄今为止最热的一个夏天。

face.name: Heat Wave
face.text: Deal 2 damage to an enemy minion and its neighbors. Quickdraw: To all enemies instead.
face.flavorText: This is the hottest summer of your life so far.

face.name: 银樽海韵
face.text: 造成 2点伤害，随机分配到所有敌方随从身上。（还剩2杯！）

face.name: Seabreeze Chalice
face.text: Deal 2 damage randomly split among all enemy minions. (2 Drinks left!)

face.name: 银樽海韵
face.text: 造成 2点伤害，随机分配到所有敌方随从身上。（最后一杯！）

face.name: Seabreeze Chalice
face.text: Deal 2 damage randomly split among all enemy minions. (Last Drink!)

face.name: 水元素
face.text: 冻结任何受到本随从伤害的角色。
face.flavorText: 千万别在晚会上召唤水元素。它会把一切都搞砸的。

face.name: Water Elemental
face.text: Freeze any character damaged by this minion.
face.flavorText: Don't summon a water elemental at a party. It'll dampen the mood.

face.name: 不稳定的骷髅
face.text: 亡语：随机对一个敌人造成2点伤害。
face.flavorText: 这些冰雕看起来好像真的！

face.name: Volatile Skeleton
face.text: Deathrattle: Deal 2 damage to a random enemy.
face.flavorText: These ice sculpures look so realistic!

uncertainties: Original deck-empty and Spell Damage improved summon cost are captured before the body, not recalculated after individual arrivals. Exact CN notifications are uncalibrated.
Native killed-result summon rewards require exact original damage/death provenance; redirection and replacement-death edges remain local.

Grand Finale counts matching actual played Elementals in the latest closed own turn, including all-tribe matching and excluding direct summons; initial scenario without prior own turn has zero repeats.
Tsunami uses existing named-summon delivery then ordinary forced attack against a current random enemy character; all three named delivery/attack steps run sequentially.
Drink successors are handed over after the split packets and their reactions; original Quickdraw acceptance selects the payload before it runs.

GDB_305 requires genuine filtered board-count price; WW_009 requires source-bound complete real Excavate inventory. These inspected public/source gaps are retained for subsequent increments, not approximated by all-minion count or the incomplete representative profile.

WW_377 has target required only unless Quickdraw is active; existing target_condition supports positive activation only. The real inverse-target gap is evidence-only here, with no always-optional or always-targeted approximation.
